# Master Services Agreement

This Agreement is made on 12 January 2026 between Northwind Ledger Systems Ltd (the "Supplier") and Harbourline Freight plc (the "Customer").

## 2. Term
2.1 This Agreement commences on 1 February 2026 and continues for an Initial Term of 36 months.
2.2 The Customer may extend the Initial Term by 12 months by giving written notice at least 3 months before the end of the Initial Term.

## 4. Delivery
4.1 The Supplier shall deliver the Phase 1 System no later than 31 March 2026.
4.2 The Supplier shall provide user training for up to 40 Customer staff.

## 7. Payment
7.1 The Customer shall pay each invoice within 30 days of the date of invoice.
7.2 Late payments shall bear interest at 3% per annum above the Bank of England base rate.

## 9. Liability
9.1 Neither party excludes liability for death or personal injury caused by its negligence.
9.2 The Supplier shall maintain professional indemnity insurance of not less than £2,000,000.

## 12. Termination
12.1 Either party may terminate this Agreement by written notice if the other party commits a material breach which is not remedied within 30 days of notice.

# Data Processing Agreement

This Agreement is made between Corvane Analytics Ltd (the "Processor") and Silverbirch Insurance Services Ltd (the "Controller").

## 3. Processor Obligations
3.1 The Processor shall process Personal Data only on the documented instructions of the Controller.
3.2 The Processor shall notify the Controller without undue delay, and in any event within 48 hours, after becoming aware of a Personal Data Breach.
3.3 The Processor shall not engage another processor without the prior specific written authorisation of the Controller.

## 4. Audit
4.1 The Controller may audit the Processor's compliance with this Agreement no more than once in any 12-month period, on not less than 30 days' notice.

## 5. Deletion
5.1 On termination, all Personal Data shall be deleted or returned at the choice of the Controller.

# Building Contract

This Contract is made between Ashcombe Build Ltd (the "Contractor") and Ferrow Estates Ltd (the "Employer").

## 2. The Works
2.1 The Contractor shall achieve Practical Completion on or before 30 September 2026.
2.2 If the Contractor fails to achieve Practical Completion by the Completion Date, the Contractor shall pay liquidated damages at the rate of £2,500 per week.

## 4. Insurance
4.1 The Contractor is required to maintain contractors' all risks insurance for not less than the full reinstatement value of the Works.

## 6. Payment
6.1 The Employer shall pay interim payments monthly, subject to a retention of 3%.
6.2 Half of the retention shall be released on Practical Completion.

# Temporary Staffing Agreement

This Agreement is made between Meridale Nursing Partners Ltd (the "Agency") and St Aldric's Community Hospital Trust (the "Client").

## 2. Supply of Workers
2.1 The Agency undertakes to supply Workers who hold current registration with the relevant professional body.
2.2 Shifts cancelled by the Client with less than 12 hours' notice shall be charged at 50% of the Shift Rate.

## 3. Client Obligations
3.1 The Client shall not engage any Worker directly within 6 months of that Worker's last shift.
3.2 If the Client engages a Worker in breach of clause 3.1, the Client shall pay the Agency a transfer fee equal to 15% of the Worker's first-year salary.

# Hosting Services Agreement

This Agreement is made between Tessellate Cloud Hosting Ltd (the "Provider") and Wrenfield Retail Ltd (the "Customer").

## 4. Service Levels
4.1 The Provider shall ensure that the Hosted Service is Available at least 99.5% of the time in each calendar month.
4.2 If Availability falls below the target in clause 4.1 in any calendar month, the Customer shall be entitled to a Service Credit equal to 5% of the monthly Fees.

## 8. Fees
8.1 The Customer shall pay monthly Fees of £7,400.

documents.text:
# First Amendment to Hosting Services Agreement

This Amendment is made on 1 September 2026 between Tessellate Cloud Hosting Ltd (the "Provider") and Wrenfield Retail Ltd (the "Customer").

1. With effect from 1 October 2026, clause 4.1 is deleted and replaced with the following: "4.1 The Provider shall ensure that the Hosted Service is Available at least 99.9% of the time in each calendar month."
2. Save as amended by this Amendment, the Agreement continues in full force and effect.
